source_document.title: Water Quality Report
source_document.page_reference: Pages 3 and 6, DS Services – Typical Analysis, Table 5: Spring
source_document.notes: The Spring table is explicitly labeled Typical Analysis rather than a single sample or calendar-year average. ND is defined by the report as not detected, absent, or present below the testing-method detection level; no numerical detection limit is supplied for the sulfate endpoint. FDA Standards of Quality are regulatory references and are not modeled as source-water chemistry.

source_normalizations.note: The source uses legacy micromho notation for a quantity explicitly labeled conductivity. The fixture normalizes it to microsiemens per centimeter for the engine conductivity quantity and does not invent a reference temperature.
